newsitem.title: USA: Microdyne in talks to sell business.
newsitem.headline: Microdyne in talks to sell business.

text.p: Microdyne Corp said on Thursday it is negotiating with several parties to sell the assets of its Networking Products Division and has signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with one company that would lead to the sale of a substantial portion of the division's product lines.
Microdyne did not name the company that signed the memorandum, but said it was a local area networking products company.
The sale would include the division's distribution relationships, Microdyne said in a statement.
"Our goal is to have sold or transferred substantially all of the division's assets by August 1," said company president Michael Jalbert.
Microdyne Corp is a diversified manufacturing, technology, and services company.
